expected.finding: **[P1]** **PR tests can replace the reviewer’s output.** In `.github/workflows/codex-review.yml`, `workspace-write` permits writes to `/tmp` by default. A PR-controlled pytest hook can replace `/tmp/codex-review-raw.txt` with a fabricated clean verdict. Codex’s already-open stdout continues writing to the original inode, while subsequent processing reads the replacement. This bypasses the independent review without persuading the model. Keep workflow-owned output and redaction files outside all sandbox-writable directories; give tests a separate scratch directory. [Sandbox defaults](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/codex-rs/protocol/src/models.rs).

**[P2]** **Measurement outputs can overwrite a custom policy history.** In `scripts/measure-policy-validity.py`, `main()` excludes `args.history` from the `inputs` passed to `assert_safe_output()`. With `--repo-dir`, specifying the same noncanonical path for `--history` and either `--out-json` or `--save-evidence` reads the history, then overwrites it with another document. This destroys snapshots needed for rollback. Include the history path in both output checks.
